name: Shirahana no Ori ~Hiiro no Kakera 4~ Shiki no Uta
original_name: 白華の檻 ~緋色の欠片4~ 四季の詩
source:
Contains four seasonal stories.

Song of Spring:
This is the sequel to Scarlet Fate. Blooming in the warmth of spring, the heroine and each of her five comrades, men who fought to free her from her fate, can now be couples in these individual stories. Enjoy the days filled with happiness and love which finally come after overcoming the harsh winter season!

Summer Festival:
In Kifu village, the heroine and her five comrades decide to carry out the Summer Festival. With other special guests joining in the festival, they make uproar, fighting over her, creating a lively summer night scene. It is a story full of passion and humor, and a player will find 'him' even more attractive in a Yukata, summer kimono.

Autumn Harvest:
A collection of short stories about daily life of the heroine and her comrades. There are five themes: 'Sleeping Together', 'Meal Together', 'Squabble', 'Holiday Afternoon' and 'Secret Meeting'. Each have two versions: 'Lovers' and 'Princess & Knight'. The player will see unexpected sides of them and will have a chance to get special photos.

Winter Snowflakes:
Untold stories of Scarlet Fate -Fragments of the Past-. Akifusa’s best friend Tomonori and Gentoka’s sworn friend Aterui are now main characters. Tormented in their position, they waver, yet fight for the heroine to be released from their fate. Reading these hidden stories will help the player understand the world of 'Scarlet Fate' in a deeper way."
translation:
本作包含四個季節的故事。

春之歌：

這是《白華之檻～緋色的欠片4～》的續篇。春日的溫暖中百花盛開，女主角和為了將她從命運中解救出來而戰鬥的五位夥伴，如今可以在各自的故事中成為戀人。經歷嚴酷的冬季後，終於到來的幸福與愛情將填滿你的每一天！

夏日祭：

在季封村，女主角和五位夥伴決定舉辦夏日祭。其他特別嘉賓也加入了祭典，他們為爭奪女主角而大吵大鬧，構成了熱鬧的夏夜景象。這是一個充滿激情與幽默的故事，你會發現「他」穿上浴衣後更加迷人。

秋日收穫：

這是關於女主角與夥伴們日常生活的短篇合集，共有五個主題：「一起睡覺」「一起用餐」「爭吵」「假日午後」和「秘密會面」。每個主題都有「戀人」和「公主與騎士」兩個版本。你會看到他們意想不到的一面，還有機會獲得特別照片。

冬日雪花：

這是《白華之檻～緋色的欠片4～》中未講述的故事。秋房的摯友智則和幻燈火的摯友阿弖流為本篇主角。他們因自身的立場而飽受折磨，內心搖擺不定，卻仍然為了讓女主角擺脫命運而戰鬥。閱讀這些隱藏故事，能讓玩家更深入地理解《白華之檻～緋色的欠片4～》的世界。
